title: Sumerian god who emerged from the water and taught civilization

tellings.quote: the Sumerian myths, right? So, here is a god who lands in the river, you know, outside of Sumer and comes up out of a vehicle of some kind

plain: In the Sumerian myths of ancient Mesopotamia, a god lands in the river outside Sumer, 'comes up out of a vehicle of some kind', and teaches people the arts of civilization. The writer Peter Levenda tells Michels this as his own reading of the myths. If it records something real, civilization would have been handed to humans by a visitor.
